description: Fixed retrieval evaluation set for Juniper. Each case maps a realistic user query to the knowledge-base topic that should be retrieved/cited (expected_title) and the categories that are acceptable to cite alongside it (acceptable_categories). Queries deliberately mix title echoes with paraphrases (e.g. 'acid reflux' -> GERD, 'heart attack' -> CAD) to test semantic retrieval, not keyword matching.

how is type 2 diabetes managed
